notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: It s a Mystery
notes.notes:
Oooh, we’ve got a bit of a “mystery” theme. Between slow burning stories and the rare survival of a… ah, survival game, this week’s selection of Unknown Pleasures is leaving me thoroughly unresolved. Leaving a trail of gross keyboard crumbs this week: space friends, snow lesbians, and evil geometry.

notes.title: Patch 3.2.2
notes.notes:
Here's a patch to improve your comet crashing experience! Version 3.2.2 should appear in your Steam client in a bit.

[h1]3.2.2 - February 20th, 2019[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a Friends leaderboard. Challenge your Steam friends too!
[*] Added support for D-pad, both in-menu and in-game. Xbox controllers should work smoothly, others might need configuration through Steam's controller utility.
[*] Added buttons to skip multiple leaderboard pages at once. Should make navigating a bit quicker.
[*] Minor stability fixes.
[/list]

[h1]3.2.1 - February 13th, 2019[/h1]
[list]
[*] The leaderboard display should now properly render Chinese, Russian, Japanese and Korean characters, as well as most emoji glyphs.
[*] Fixed the leaderboard occasionally showing a wrong number of pages.
[*] Fixed various minor display issues.
[/list]

As always, if you have any issues, feel free to post in the discussions board.
